title: Cross-repo error/problem registry (IC4, Train A)
description: Script-readable registry of every failure surface Core owns and how each repo adopts it. Kept in sync with the compiled sources by test/ErrorRegistry.test.ts (drift fails the Core test gate). Source files: src/shared/FailureTaxonomy.ts (kinds), src/shared/errors/BaseError.ts (classes), src/shared/DiagnosticCodes.ts (diagnostic reason codes).

alembicCore.proof: test/ErrorRegistry.test.ts verifies this registry byte-matches the compiled taxonomy, error classes and diagnostic codes; test/FailureTaxonomy.test.ts validates the taxonomy invariants.

alembic.detail: buildAlembicHttpProblem maps all 16 failure kinds to HTTP problems via getCoreFailureTaxonomyEntry (@alembic/core/shared); httpStatus/retryPolicy/exposure come from the Core entries.
alembic.adoptionPath: already consuming Core authority; no further step this wave

alembicAgent.decision: DOCUMENT, do not integrate (Train A IC4 ruling, 2026-06-12)
alembicAgent.reasoning: classifyLlmError is transport-level retry/circuit-breaker classification for outbound LLM provider calls (abort/network/429/5xx + 7 undici/network cause codes). Its output never crosses a user-facing wire: callers are AiProvider retry orchestration and reliability.ts circuit breaking. Integrating it with the Core failure taxonomy would couple Agent's hot retry path to a registry designed for surfaced failures, with no consumer benefit and a real regression risk in retry semantics.
alembicAgent.integrationTrigger: re-rule only if Agent failure classifications start crossing a surfaced boundary (HTTP/MCP/Dashboard); owner: AlembicAgent window

alembicPlugin.surface: MCP Zod validator (derives Core shapes) + clean-error envelopes
alembicPlugin.adoptionProof: AlembicPlugin commit e96dbf1 (P3 step 7): top-level toolName on clean error envelopes + error-registry adoption verified against this registry
alembicPlugin.adoptionPath: adopted ahead of IC5 during the P3 plugin train; the post-CKG IC5 wave re-verifies only if the validator surface changes

alembicDashboard.adoptionPath: Train B IC2 generated artifact carries the failure-kind enum + problem envelope from this registry's sources

CO3-TAXONOMY-FACADE-PROMOTION.change: promote PersistenceError and DivergenceError onto the ./shared facade (src/shared/index.ts explicit error re-export list gains both names)
CO3-TAXONOMY-FACADE-PROMOTION.gateImpact: closeout.narrowness.baselines['./shared'] must be raised 189 -> 191 in config/public-api-boundary.json — a shrink-only budget raise that REQUIRES a controller decision recorded in the policy file (per docs/public-api-gates.md)
CO3-TAXONOMY-FACADE-PROMOTION.notShippedReason: boundary gate pins ./shared at 189; consumers currently match the classes via BaseError + stable codes PERSISTENCE_ERROR / STATE_DIVERGENCE
CO3-TAXONOMY-FACADE-PROMOTION.trigger: 0.3.0 release wave executes the two-line facade edit + the recorded budget decision together
